tools.name: url_html

tools.name: url_similarity

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "web" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: url_html, google_image_search, google_maps_search, google_lens_search, youtube_comments, tiktok_search_create, tiktok_video_create · Private data: download_youtube_video, youtube_audio_download · Public sink: google_lens_search, youtube_search, youtube_metadata, instagram_post, x_post, instagram_comments_create.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: url_html, google_image_search, google_maps_search, google_lens_search, youtube_comments, tiktok_search_create, tiktok_video_create · Private data: download_youtube_video, youtube_audio_download · Public sink: google_lens_search, youtube_search, youtube_metadata, instagram_post, x_post, instagram_comments_create

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
